summary: The Android stream encoder wrapper previously bypassed frame adaptation whenever input width matched the configured width, even if height had changed. It now compares both dimensions and adapts mismatched frames using the complete source rectangle. This closes a concrete orientation/resize gap but does not prove the reported receiver crop was caused by it or is now fixed.
